cases.reason: The required GET request paths and network rejection handling exist, but calling a local lookup does not establish usable failure fallback across the admitted product-ID domain. A valid remote-list product with id 42 is preserved by mapping and routed to detail. If that detail request fails, local commodityById(42) returns undefined because the fixed mock set contains only IDs 1 through 8. The type assertion creates no object. CommodityDetail assigns that result and keeps its loading branch. This source-decidable contradiction invalidates the complete-requirement PASS without requiring or claiming a device/server execution.

evidence.finding: Full original obligation requires both GET operations and automatic local-mock fallback keeping the app usable, with no local-ID-only exception. The complete original GT was reviewed.
Original PRD expressly permits conditional mock fallback after request failure; using mock is not itself a defect.
Remote list records are accepted, but both detail-fallback branches merely cast commodityById(id), which may remain undefined.
Only IDs 1 through 8 are in the mock set; find returns undefined for an admitted remote ID such as 42.
Selected product ID is routed unchanged to CommodityDetail; Repository:62-69 preserves the remote ID as a number.
Requested ID reaches fetchDetail and its undefined result is assigned directly to commodity.
Falsy commodity takes the loading-only branch rather than usable detail display.
Scope explicitly permits source implementation paths and concrete contradictions; actual runtime acceptance remains separate.

cases.reason: Within the explicitly requested source-implementation sub-proof, the repository retains both required GET operations and routes request errors to usable local mock data. Its detail fallback returns the matching local product when present, otherwise constructs a Commodity using a guaranteed nonempty local sample and the requested ID. Both failure and falsy-result branches use that helper, so remote IDs outside 1 through 8 no longer produce undefined. Caller/source configuration checks support the additional assertions. This is a source-path PASS, with no claim of actual network/device execution or full-project acceptance.

HTTP GET request, error rejection, non-200 rejection and JSON-parse rejection are explicit source paths.
Caller passes the routed ID and assigns the repository object. Current F11 caller and configuration hashes match the directly inspected copies from the same frozen batch.

issues.message: The actual PASS equates invoking MockData.commodityById with a complete usable fallback. Remote list IDs are unrestricted by the local 1..8 set; a detail request failure for id 42 yields undefined and a loading-only page. The label and complete-coverage diagnosis are unsupported despite genuine citations.
